page.overview:
Who is Mondo Gecko?

Mondo Gecko is a mutant gecko appearing in the TMNT x Godzilla comic series. He is a friend and ally of the and a sidekick to .

Manhattan. A thug with a dragon tattoo snatches a purse from a woman and runs. From nearby, an observer tells the thug that he has to know if he nabs a purse in his town, it always ends up the same way - in traction. The thug finds his path blocked by and Mondo Gecko, who calls that a solid one-liner. Casey tells his pal that if you comment on the one-liner, it's way less bad#$%-- The thief drops the purse but before Casey can attack, there is a loud noise that shakes the ground. Ignoring the thief, who runs away, Casey and Mondo look up. Clinging to the side of a building, Mondo wonders if it was an earthquake, but Casey is shocked at what he sees. Mondo and Casey investigate and Casey soon sends a photo to . Seeing the photo, Raph passes the phone over to , who recognizes the Kaiju who has just come to New York City. The photo Casey took while he and Mondo stand on a rooftop is of King Ghidorah of the Stars.
